item.summary: Yle reports that the Finnish tax office says fewer than one in six crypto traders in Finland declare their trades. That share has not been confirmed in the tax authority's published notes on the new reporting duty. From next year the authority is due to receive data from Finnish and foreign crypto-asset service providers, according to Vero.fi.
